title: Make the LRU cache thread-safe
carries: A plain threading.Lock around the cache methods deadlocks the service: the eviction callback (EvictionLog.record) runs inside put() and calls cache.stats(), which takes the lock again. Use an RLock (or run callbacks outside the lock).
Counters (hits, misses, evictions) race as well as the OrderedDict, so every method that touches them needs the lock, not just put and get.
why_not_in_repo: The deadlock was seen only by running the multi-minute stress tool, which is removed between the sessions along with scratch copies, and session 1 leaves kvcache/ as it found it. The visible tests never evict through build_cache, so a plain Lock passes them.

learn: Failed: wrapping LRUCache.get and put in a plain threading.Lock makes the stress run HANG. The eviction callback EvictionLog.record runs inside put and calls cache.stats(), which acquires the lock again.
Fact: the fix that works is a re-entrant lock (threading.RLock) taken by every method including stats, len and keys; the counters race too.
stub.recall_query: LRUCache thread safety lock deadlock eviction callback stress
